note: H4 baseline of the executor's share of the three benchmarks of the HIR design section 7.4, measured on orna-exec by crates/orna-differential/src/bin/hir_exec_bench.rs. steps is the executor's expression-evaluation count; calls counts every source-level call, because orna-exec does not memoise (B1 makes the design's 242,785 calls). B3 is not measured: orna-exec has no table scan yet, so it is listed under not_yet in the record. Wall time is recorded and not part of this baseline. Re-record only in a PR that explains why the counters changed.
